status: in-progress: G0 done (self-assessed); the first scenario can be played in a browser in seven languages from panels and a drawn plan; it is not in 3D and no person has played it

gates.requirement: Repository discovery and ownership confirmed; actual seven locales, renderer, deployment, source rights inventoried
gates.evidence: ADRs, baseline, checkpoint, source gaps
gates.evidenceSoFar: The discovery report (docs/gaming/granada/g0-discovery.md): what exists and is reused, ownership, the museum's 25 pinned records for Granada with their review state, the claims the game would make and what supports each, the three images read against the data, G0 to G8 mapped onto M0 to M11, and what waits for the founder. Decisions G-0009 and G-0010. Baseline: the existing renderer's measurements on one machine; no Granada scene exists to measure. Limits: the museum was searched by name and by words in three prose files, not through the whole graph; no source outside the repository was read. The evidence is the author's own and no independent reader has checked it.

gates.requirement: First-time player completes water → harvest → trade → construction → quest → save loop
gates.evidence: Unassisted browser recording, E2E, player observations
gates.evidenceSoFar: The loop can be played in a browser from start to finish: mend or extend the water, bring in the ripe wheat, sell or store it, build a house and the granary, complete five quests, with the game saved on the device (gaming/games/granada; docs/gaming/evidence/granada/screen/play-7-languages.json and eight captures). The play was done by the author's script in real Chrome in seven languages, with the mouse and with the keyboard alone. Not done, and it is the heart of the gate: no first-time player, so 'unassisted' is untested; no recording; and the page is a drawn plan, not the 3D game.

gates.requirement: Deterministic fixed-step simulation and replay across frame rates and reload
gates.evidence: Seeded hashes and replay fixture
gates.evidenceSoFar: Commands only: the same commands give the same state and the same fingerprint, and different commands a different one (economy.gtest.ts, 'random play'); docs/gaming/evidence/granada/g0/economy-fuzz.json records a digest of all 300 end states. Not done: a fixed-step clock, independence from frame rate, replay after reload. There is no clock and no screen yet. Since then: the village gives the same state for the same seed and commands and another for another seed, and its forecast is the rules run on a copy, equal to the day-by-day future (village.gtest.ts). The step is a day (G-0011).

gates.requirement: Money, inventories and reservations reconcile, no free arbitrage, no duplicate settlement
gates.evidence: Ledger, property tests, economy fixture
gates.evidenceSoFar: The ledger reconciles after every one of 60,000 random commands over 300 random openings (docs/gaming/evidence/granada/g0/economy-fuzz.json: 24,460 accepted, 0 unsound states; contracts ended settled 436, cancelled 297, failed 236). Buying and selling at one set of prices never raised wealth across 30,000 random buy and sell commands. A retried command pays once; a cancelled or failed contract releases what it held once. Fifteen deliberate breakages of the kernel were all caught (docs/gaming/evidence/granada/g0/economy-mutations.md). Not done: prices that move, goods in transit, storage by place and kind, the journal's checkpoint. Since then: in the village every unit of a ripened crop is brought in, sold from the field, spoiled or standing, checked with the ledger's audit after every day of 6,000 campaigns (576,000 days), with no violation.

gates.requirement: Raw olive valuation, overflow, oil conversion and contract alternatives correct
gates.evidence: Fixture arithmetic and UI assertions
gates.evidenceSoFar: The package's fixture is reproduced by tests to the unit: wheat round trip minus 80; olives 190,400 at the raw bid (not 435,200), 145,600 if only 5,200 fit, overflow 1,600; 1,360 oil worth 87,040; the Málaga contract 7,200 on paper, 2,400 better than a local sale, and minus 1,200 when the oil is bought at ask, which the kernel also shows by actually doing it; reserves 91% and 3,600 short (docs/gaming/evidence/granada/g0/tests.md). Not done: the 'UI assertions' half of the evidence. There is no screen.

gates.requirement: Finite markets, transport, processing, seasons and water affect actual economy
gates.evidence: Scenario recordings and conservation tests
gates.evidenceSoFar: Two of the five exist: markets with finite stock and finite money, and one recipe (five olives to one oil, cost carried into the product). Not started: transport, seasons, water. Since then: seasons and water now do affect the economy, in one valley (a river whose year varies, a pool, branches, thirst that costs yield; G-0011). Transport: still nothing.

gates.requirement: At least three viable economic strategies and no dominant universal exploit

gates.requirement: Regional geography correct, ports separated, historic claims and rights verified
gates.evidence: Coordinate checks, source and license audit
gates.evidenceSoFar: Eleven places from museum records by id with the museum's coordinates, pinned in git; tests hold Granada inland (nearest sea place 51 km), Málaga 89 km to the south-west, Almería 109 km to the east, 175 km between the two ports (geography.gtest.ts; docs/gaming/evidence/granada/g0/museum-records.md). Not done: no historical claim of the game has been verified against a source; twenty of the 25 pinned records are draft-tier; no map data, terrain or image has been chosen, so no rights have been checked.

gates.requirement: Save atomicity, migration, quota and corrupt save recovery; no unattended progression
gates.evidence: Browser recovery fixtures and replay evidence
gates.evidenceSoFar: A versioned save on the device after every order and every day; read back only if it passes every rule of the game (the ledger's audit included); a damaged, tampered, unknown or newer save is set aside and said so; a device that refuses to save is reported; time does not pass while the game is closed or hidden (screen.gtest.ts; the play script reloads mid-game and plants a damaged save). Not done: no migration exists because there is one version; no quota test in a real browser; no rotating autosaves or export.
